observer_input.overall_task: Participants discuss a One Night Ultimate Werewolf game after its night actions and decide whom to accuse or vote for. Statements about roles and actions are reports that may be disputed or strategic. Preserve the distinction between a reported initial role, a role after a reported exchange, and a current role. Use the publicly spoken instructions in this prefix for the variant; do not infer hidden cards or final votes.

context_sources.text:
Everyone close your eyes. Werewolves, wake up and look for other Werewolves. If there is only one Werewolf, you may look at a card from the center. Werewolves, close your eyes. Masons, wake up and look for the other Mason. Masons, close your eyes. Seer, wake up. You may look at another player's card or two of the center cards. Seer close your eyes. Robber, wake up. You may exchange your card with another player's card, and then view your new card. Robber close your eyes. Troublemaker, wake up. You may exchange cards between two other players. Troublemaker, close your eyes. Drunk, wake up and exchange your card with a card from the center. Drunk, close your eyes. Insomniac, wake up and look at your card.
Insomniac, close your eyes. Everyone, keep your eyes closed and reach out and move your card around slightly.
Everyone, wake up.

dialogue_prefix.text: We've got six minutes figure to this shit out.

dialogue_prefix.text: She's not that villager, because I am!

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Audrey
dialogue_prefix.text: So I was the Robber, and I took Dylan's card. And Dylan was the Seer, so don't let him pull any malarkey. I switched our cards, so he's now a Robber.

dialogue_prefix.text: Sounds like something two Werewolves would say.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Katie
dialogue_prefix.text: Wait, two were... are you saying you're both Werewolves?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Audrey
dialogue_prefix.text: That we switched with each other.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Audrey
dialogue_prefix.text: It's so hard, cause I don't want anybody to feel me move, so I have to do what's next to me.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Dylan
dialogue_prefix.text: So we're really in a bubble right now.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Katie
dialogue_prefix.text: Please say their cards, because that would be hilarious.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Brett
dialogue_prefix.text: Well, I'll say I hate my role.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Dylan
dialogue_prefix.text: The Werewolf, I hate it too!

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Dan
dialogue_prefix.text: I don't like Werewolves at all.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Brett
dialogue_prefix.text: I was the drunk. I was the drunk. I switched one from the middle.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Katie
dialogue_prefix.text: So I can say that, right?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Katie
dialogue_prefix.text: Although I will say... thanks for asking. Sorry, that was really loud. Watch the second video. There was only one Mason. So there's another Mason card in the middle. I was all by myself.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Brett
dialogue_prefix.text: Wait, so are you a Mason?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: Brett
dialogue_prefix.text: So, oh you're claiming the Troublemaker. What did you do, Ed?
